headline: Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Intimation under Regulation 30 & 42 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 about fixation of Wednesday, July 22, 2026 as the Demerger Record Date…
detail: Updates - Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Intimation under Regulation 30 & 42 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 about fixation of Wednesday, July 22, 2026 as the Demerger Record Date pursuant to the Scheme'.
